title: 第25章 接收矿脉阴险刘家第26章 因祸得福庞大矿脉
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“馨儿姐，你当然行。”
感受着怀里面的温软，以及淡淡的体香味传来。
林晨伸出手将林馨儿揽在怀中，轻轻的拍了拍林馨儿后背，以示安慰。
“呃……”
林馨儿感受到林晨胸膛传来的温度，也是忍不住满脸羞红，赶紧从林晨怀里面收回来。
虽然小时候玩游戏，自己经常把这家伙背在背上。
可，那毕竟是小时候。
现在都长大了。
根本不敢去看林晨的脸颊，内心噗通噗通跳个不停。
“薛会长，我就把馨儿姐交给你了，你可得给我好生指导。”
林晨内心也是忍不住感叹。
他轮回九世，几乎都是埋头苦修，对于男女之情也是一片空白。
如今。
在林家生活十六年，他以少年心性与林馨儿和林雨菲相处，却感觉到无比的轻松惬意。
兴许轮回百万年，经历过无数的生离死别。
平凡之路，或许显得更加尤为珍贵。
“林少说的哪里话，能够指点馨儿小姐，乃是我的荣幸。”
薛松内心都是激动。
以他的眼力见，何尝看不出来，眼前的林晨和林馨儿关系非同一般。
林晨虽然姓林，却是林毅的义子，与林馨儿也没有任何血缘关系。

最重要的是。
以刚才林馨儿展现出来的天赋，假以时日必然是耀眼的炼丹师天才。
他现在能够指点林馨儿，就等于卖给未来的耀眼的炼丹师一个人情，兴许他在天龙商会的地位，还会随着林馨儿上升呢。
这样的机会摆在眼前，他可不是傻子。
自然会全力抓住。
“馨儿姐，你以后就在天龙商会借用地火，有什么困难，就直接来告诉薛会长，反正天龙商会有的是资源。”
林晨对着林馨儿淡淡一笑，转身就朝着外面走去。
薛松能够成为天龙商会的会长，也不是傻子，必然是很精明的人。
将林馨儿交给薛松，他倒是很放心。
“晨弟，李李你。”
林馨儿看着林晨离去的背影，她虽然表面性格温顺，实则内心却很坚强。
想到林晨能够带着她来到天龙商会，给她这么好的资源，就为了让她成为炼丹师。
她心里面已经暗暗下定决心，一定不能够让林晨失望。
紧接着，
林馨儿转身，就来到地火熔炉旁边，施展出炼丹手法《太乙九式》第一式“凝火式”
content_en:
"Sister Xin'er, of course you can do it."
Feel the warmth and softness in your arms, as well as the faint body fragrance.
Lin Chen stretched out his hand to hold Lin Xiner in his arms, and gently patted Lin Xiner's back to express comfort.
"Uh..."
Lin Xiner felt the warmth coming from Lin Chen's chest, and couldn't help but blush with embarrassment, and quickly withdrew from Lin Chen's arms.
Although I played games when I was a kid, I often carried this guy on my back.
But, after all, that was when I was a kid.
All grown up now.
He didn't dare to look at Lin Chen's face at all, and his heart was pounding.
"President Xue, I will leave Sister Xin'er to you. You must give me good guidance."
Lin Chen couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
During his nine reincarnations, he spent most of his life practicing hard and was completely blank about the relationship between men and women.
now.
Living in the Lin family for sixteen years, he had a young mind to get along with Lin Xiner and Lin Yufei, but he felt extremely relaxed and comfortable.
Maybe he has been reincarnated for millions of years and experienced countless life, separation and death.
The ordinary road may seem even more precious.
"It's my honor to be able to point out what Mr. Lin said to Miss Xin'er."
Xue Song was excited inside.
With his eyesight, he couldn't tell that the relationship between Lin Chen and Lin Xiner in front of him was extraordinary.
Although Lin Chen's surname is Lin, he is Lin Yi's adopted son and has no blood relationship with Lin Xiner.
The most important thing is.
With the talent that Lin Xiner showed just now, in time she will definitely become a dazzling alchemist genius.
Now that he can advise Lin Xiner, it is equivalent to selling a favor to the future dazzling alchemist. Maybe his status in the Tianlong Chamber of Commerce will rise with Lin Xiner.
With such an opportunity before him, he is no fool.
Naturally, I will seize it with all my strength.
"Sister Xin'er, from now on you can borrow earth fire from the Tianlong Chamber of Commerce. If you have any difficulties, just come and tell President Xue directly. Anyway, the Tianlong Chamber of Commerce has plenty of resources."
Lin Chen smiled faintly at Lin Xiner, turned around and walked outside.
Xue Song can become the president of Tianlong Chamber of Commerce, he is not a fool, he must be a very smart person.
He felt relieved when he handed Lin Xiner over to Xue Song.
"Brother Chen, Li Li, you."
Lin Xiner looked at Lin Chen's leaving figure. Although she had a gentle personality on the surface, she was actually very strong on the inside.
Thinking that Lin Chen could bring her to the Tianlong Chamber of Commerce and give her such good resources just to make her an alchemist.
She had secretly made up her mind that she would not let Lin Chen down.
Immediately afterwards,
Lin Xiner turned around and came to the ground fire furnace, performing the first "Fire Condensing Style" of the "Nine Taiyi Styles" of the alchemy technique.
